name: Slack
entity_note: Slack Technologies (Salesforce) workplace messaging; developer docs moved from api.slack.com to docs.slack.dev.
description: Team messaging platform; Web API for channels, messages, users, files plus Events API and Socket Mode.
min_plan: Free workspace or free Developer Program sandbox (some AI features need a paid plan)

evidence.quote: Slack apps are installed with a v2 OAuth 2.0 flow.
Copy the bot token ( xoxb- ) from OAuth & Permissions . For Socket Mode, create an app-level token ( xapp- ) with connections:write under Basic Information .
Some AI features need a paid plan; a free Developer Program sandbox has them.
apps intended for commercial distribution should be submitted and approved for listing in the Slack Marketplace.
Click Activate Public Distribution . Once distribution is enabled, you'll get access to an embeddable Add to Slack button
Web API Tier 2 20+ per minute Most methods allow at least 20 requests per minute
Slack supports JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP. All requests should be sent to: https://mcp.slack.com/mcp
Remote MCP over HTTP with OAuth. Your workspace admin may need to approve it.

needs_human: Unlisted public distribution works without review, but Marketplace review is expected for commercial apps and non-Marketplace apps may face tighter rate limits on some methods (e.g. conversations.history); confirm whether access_prod should be app_review.

name: Twilio
entity_note: Twilio Inc. cloud communications (SMS, voice, WhatsApp, email, Verify).
description: Communications platform APIs for SMS/MMS, voice calls, WhatsApp, email (SendGrid) and verification.
min_plan: Free trial (restricted to verified numbers); upgrade to pay-as-you-go paid account for production

evidence.quote: To authenticate requests to the Twilio APIs, use HTTP Basic authentication . Use your API key SID as the username and your API key secret as the password.
Verified recipients : You can only send to verified phone numbers (up to 5 per account).
Click Upgrade when you're ready to move to a paid account.
This is a monorepo for the Model Context Protocol server that exposes all of Twilio APIs.
"-y", "@twilio-alpha/mcp", "YOUR_ACCOUNT_SID/YOUR_API_KEY:YOUR_API_SECRET"

needs_human: MCP is published under the twilio-labs GitHub org as 'Twilio Alpha' (experimental, local npx); confirm it counts as official. Twilio also documents OAuth Apps (not verified here); US SMS production also needs A2P 10DLC registration.

name: Zoho Cliq
entity_note: Zoho Corporation's team chat app Cliq.
description: Team chat/collaboration app (chats, channels, bots, users) with a REST API v2.

evidence.quote: Zoho Cliq's Rest API's follows the OAuth 2.0 protocol to authorize and authenticate requests.
Register your application as a new client by accessing this website: https://accounts.zoho.com/developerconsole
Zoho Cliq is hosted at multiple data centers, and therefore available on different domains. There are 6 different domains for Zoho Cliq's APIs
There is no usage limit on the API.
Plan Monthly Billing Annual Billing Free Free Free Standard US$18/month (up to 25 users)
MCP integrates with many Zoho apps, including CRM, Mail, Calendar, Desk, Cliq, Projects, and WorkDrive.
With Zoho MCP, you can create MCP Servers that expose tools, actions, and contextual data from Zoho apps

needs_human: Zoho MCP generates per-user server URLs rather than one fixed endpoint; confirm whether API access is available on the Free Cliq plan (pricing page lists Free plan but API gating per plan not verified). Maintenance APIs are org-admin only.

name: Lark (Larksuite)
entity_note: Lark is the international version of ByteDance's Feishu collaboration suite; open platform at open.larksuite.com (Feishu equivalent at open.feishu.cn).
description: All-in-one collaboration suite (messaging, calendar, docs, Base, meetings, approvals) with a broad Open Platform API.
min_plan: Free Starter plan (per vendor meta description; limits not verified)

evidence.quote: tenant_access_token : 以应用身份调用 API 时需要使用的凭证，可读写的数据范围由应用的数据权限范围决定。
获取 user_access_token 是标准的 OAuth 2.0
出于安全考虑，你需要为应用申请相应的权限，并且由企业管理员审核通过后，应用才可以进行后续的 API 调用或事件监听。
创建自建应用或者商店应用。（仅拥有 ISV 资质的用户可以创建商店应用）
Lark offers multiple pricing plans from a free starter pack to a pro and an enterprise plan.
This is the Feishu/Lark official OpenAPI MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool designed to help users quickly connect to the Feishu/Lark platform
**⚠️ Beta Version Notice**: This tool is currently in Beta stage.

needs_human: Docs site is a JS shell; pricing page not readable (free Starter only from meta description). Multi-tenant distribution (store apps) requires ISV qualification and scopes need tenant-admin approval - confirm partner_review. Feishu (China) and Lark are separate regional platforms.

name: Pumble
entity_note: Pumble team chat by CAKE.com Inc. (makers of Clockify).
description: Team chat and video collaboration app (Slack alternative) with an API addon and app platform.
min_plan: Free (API addon available on all plans)

evidence.quote: This addon lets you generate an API key that allows you to send messages, reactions, and more via simple HTTP requests.
Who can use this feature? Owner, Admin, Member Available on all plans
The rate limit is up to 1000 requests per minute per user.
"pumble-mcp": { "type": "http", "url": "https://mcp.pumble.com/mcp", "headers": { "token": "user/bot token" "x-app-token": "xpat-token" }
The list of available MCP tools is dynamic and depends entirely on the specific scopes you selected when creating an app.

needs_human: API-key addon covers a narrow set of actions (messages, reactions, channels); Pumble also has an app platform with app/user/bot tokens (used by MCP) whose OAuth flow and multi-workspace distribution rules were not verified.

name: Discord
entity_note: Discord chat platform; developer docs now at docs.discord.com/developers.
description: Community chat/voice platform; HTTP API plus Gateway WebSocket for bots, interactions, guilds, channels and messages.

evidence.quote: authentication is performed with the Authorization HTTP header in the format Authorization: TOKEN_TYPE TOKEN .
Example Bot Token Authorization Header Authorization: Bot
OAuth2 and Permissions
For verified apps (required for apps in 100+ guilds), the intent must also be approved after the verification process to use the intent.
Currently, those intents include: GUILD_PRESENCES GUILD_MEMBERS MESSAGE_CONTENT
All HTTP-layer services and protocols (e.g. HTTP, WebSocket) within the Discord API are using TLS 1.2.
This Model Context Protocol server provides search and retrieval tools for the Documentation - Discord site.

needs_human: No vendor MCP for the Discord API found (only a docs-search MCP on docs.discord.com, likely auto-generated by the docs host). Free-to-start; verification is required only past 100 guilds and for privileged intents - confirm access_prod=app_review is the right label. 'other' auth = 'Bot' token type.

name: Telegram
entity_note: Telegram messenger; extracted for the Telegram Bot API (bot accounts). A separate MTProto client API (api_id/api_hash for user accounts) also exists and was not assessed.
description: Messaging app; Bot API lets bots send/receive messages, manage chats, payments and Mini Apps over HTTPS.
min_plan: Free (paid broadcasts above 30 msg/s cost Telegram Stars)

evidence.quote: Each bot is given a unique authentication token when it is created .
All queries to the Telegram Bot API must be served over HTTPS and need to be presented in this form: https://api.telegram.org/bot token /METHOD_NAME .
By default, bots are able to message their users at no cost – but have limitations on the number of messages they can broadcast in a single interval
Each message broadcasted over the free amount of 30 per second incurs a cost of 0.1 Stars per message

needs_human: No vendor MCP found in core.telegram.org docs (absence not provable by quote). Auth is a bot token placed in the URL path - mapped to api_key. Decide whether the toolkit should target Bot API or MTProto user API.

name: WhatsApp Business
entity_note: Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API), not the consumer WhatsApp Business mobile app (which has no API).
description: Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform Cloud API for sending/receiving business messages, templates, phone numbers and webhooks.
min_plan: Free developer access with test number; per-message charges for template messages in production

evidence.quote: If you are a **direct developer**, meaning only you or your business accesses your own data, use a [System User access token](#system-user-access-tokens).
If you are a **Tech Provider**, use a [Business Integration System User access token]
As a Tech Provider, you can independently provide all WhatsApp messaging services to clients who you have onboarded
you can start the app review process . Click Start verification to verify your business.
Effective July 1, 2025 – Meta charges on a **per-message basis**, aligned to industry standards.
| Endpoint | `https://mcp.facebook.com/whatsapp_business_tools` | | Authentication | Meta developer account sign-in (OAuth) |
The interface and tool set of the WhatsApp Business Tools MCP server are in beta and may change.

needs_human: Serving other businesses requires becoming a Tech Provider with business verification + App Review (and Embedded Signup); this is closer to kyc_verification+app_review. Official MCP is beta and acts on apps/businesses you administer. admin_only_credential=true assumes System User tokens are created by business admins - not quote-verified.

name: Aircall
entity_note: Aircall cloud phone system for sales/support teams.
description: Cloud call-center/phone system; Public API for calls, users, numbers, contacts, tags and webhooks.
min_plan: Aircall customer account (API keys) or approved Technology Partner developer account (4-month trial, extendable)

evidence.quote: With Aircall Public API, Authentication can be done through OAuth or Basic Auth.
As an Aircall customer, an api_id and api_token are needed to use Aircall Public API: go to your Company's Settings page .
In Aircall, integrations are enabled at the Company level, which means they can only be set by an Admin user.
please use the OAuth flow . It is a requirement to be listed on the Aircall App Marketplace. You can create a partner-specific account by signing up here !
Expect review feedback within one to five business days, after which you receive developer and OAuth credentials.
A public app is designed for many Aircall customers, uses OAuth, and goes through review.
Does Aircall offer an MCP server As of this writting we don't offer an MCP servier but stay tuned.

needs_human: Without an Aircall subscription, dev credentials require an approved Technology Partner application. Aircall's MCP docs are about Aircall AI consuming partner MCP servers, not exposing Aircall's API. Paid plan tier needed for API keys not verified.

name: Vonage
entity_note: Vonage Communications APIs (formerly Nexmo), developer.vonage.com; not Vonage Business Cloud UCaaS or Contact Center.
description: CPaaS APIs for SMS, Messages (WhatsApp/RCS/etc.), Voice, Video, Verify, Numbers and Network APIs.
min_plan: Free account with €2 test credit in DEMO mode; top up (pay-as-you-go) for production

evidence.quote: Some APIs require Vonage Application JWTs signed with RS256. Some APIs are Basic Auth only, including Numbers, Application, Account, Reports, Audit, Redact, and Verify v1.
Messages supports both JWT and Basic authentication, however basic authentication does not support webhooks or advanced features such as ACLs.
When you create your Vonage account you are given €2 free test credit and your account is set in DEMO mode.
US A2P SMS requires 10 DLC registration before sending
"type" : "stdio" , "command" : "npx" , "args" : [ "-y" , "@vonage/vonage-mcp-server-api-bindings" ]
"vonage-docs" : { "url" : "https://documentation-mcp.vonage.dev/mcp" , "type" : "http"

needs_human: Two official MCPs: a local npx 'API bindings' server (acts on the API) and a remote docs-only server (https://documentation-mcp.vonage.dev/mcp). DEMO mode limits sends to a small set of destination numbers until top-up. 'websocket' reflects Voice API WebSocket audio streaming, not quote-verified here.
